title: Migrate markdown tickets to JSON + generate formal schema file
objective: Migrate existing markdown ticket files to structured JSON format and generate a formal JSON Schema file (SCHEMA.md) for ticket validation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Legacy markdown tickets are migrated to structured JSON ticket files.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/tickets/ticket-*.json (35 files); legacy markdown preserved under docs/tickets/archive/

acceptance_criteria.text: A formal JSON Schema file is published for ticket validation.
Schema field semantics match the engine and the decision logs.
acceptance_criteria.note: Reviewed manually against engine.ts and DECISIONS D/E/J on 2026-10-26; no automated JSON-Schema validator is wired into Jest yet.

needed: add an ajv-based schema-validation test for ticket-v1.json
